public_API.prepare_production(request_path): Read a pinned-request JSON path. Validate all inputs before creating output_root. Return Prepared-READY pin dictionary. No process or Java execution.
public_API.prepare_tests(production_ready_pin, actu: Read dictionaries {path,bytes,sha256}. Revalidate the frozen request and original inputs plus exact Native production output manifest. Create only the previously absent tests subdirectory. Return Prepared-READY pin dictionary.
public_API.RecipeError: ValueError subclass with stable .code and .detail; all supported refusals use named code. No approvals or leases are emitted.

request.output_root: absolute D path, absent, parent already exists, resolved under D; no symlink redirection
request.production_class: fully qualified top-level name matching package and source stem
request.test_class: fully qualified top-level name matching package and source stem
request.methods: nonempty unique list of simple Java method identifiers, not selectors, class names, scans or signatures
request.templates: object with prod_config,prod_args,test_config,test_args,junit_args pins; exact qualified 748/750-shaped templates
request.sdk_declaration: pin to external Native issuer declaration described below

Native_sdk_declaration.sources: object production/test exact source pins; binds declaration to this selected unit
Native_sdk_declaration.sdk_verified: pin to corresponding VERIFIED with actual reference
Native_sdk_declaration.sdk_args: pin to original production argfile, exact 316-entry tail
Native_sdk_declaration.sdk_entries: ordered 316 paths identical to decoded sdk_args CP; duplicates retained
Native_sdk_declaration.required_families: object production/test, each explicit FQN list reviewed by Native; test may include selected production_class
Native_sdk_declaration.families: object FQN -> {index,root,relative,pin}; first-hit directory class from SDK entries, not an approval boolean; production_class excluded because it binds future actual prefix

production_output_binding: Native ACTUAL must reference generated production CONFIG, phase=prod, exact command, success with no timeout/error/pin change, and nonempty class pins under generated production/classes. VERIFIED must reference that ACTUAL and same classes. Actual manifest must exactly equal existing *.class leaves; selected top-level class must exist. No new compilation is performed by the preparer.
output: output_root/production/{CONFIG.json,PROD.args,PREPARED-READY.json,classes,empty-source}; after actual binding output_root/tests/{CONFIG.json,TEST.args,JUNIT.args,PREPARED-READY.json,classes-test,empty-source,reports,tmp}. CONFIG retains original runner-consumed field shapes. Prepared readiness means metadata prepared, not Native-approved or executed.
trust_boundary: Native declaration is externally supplied review evidence. Tool validates identity and consistency, never infers ABI/source qualification from an old successful compilation. Only the Native owner can issue the declaration for real use. Tests may use isolated synthetic declarations as DATA, never as real SDK approvals.
